conviction_note: This is not an ordinary results print. Saikaya has been a 整理銘柄 since 2026-09-16 and is due to delist on 2027-03-01, and its parent AFC-HD (2927, also reporting 10/15) has scheduled the share-exchange agreement for 'mid-October 2026'. The day therefore most likely turns on the exchange ratio rather than on the quarter. abs_move_pct is 7: roughly a 65% chance the terms land with today's release and move the stock 8-15% toward ratio x AFC price, otherwise 2-3%. p_up is 54, a slight lean up, because Japanese parent-subsidiary exchanges usually carry a premium over the 1-month average (about 316 yen) and the company itself bought back stock in August at about 373-377 yen. Against that, spot 342 already holds a 16% run-in since 9/16. The findings sum (+0.6) and the scaled number (+0.56) agree, and both are small against a wide two-sided band.
bar: Company FY8/2026 forecast (published 2025-10-15, unchanged in the Q3 短信 of 2026-07-15): sales 4,800m, OP 150m, ordinary 140m, NI 120m, dividend 5 yen. https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594387.pdf . No 四季報/IFIS figure sourced. The share-exchange ratio has no sourced bar at all; spot 342 = 0.404 x AFC-HD's 846 is the only implied one.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0%, no disclosed seller, unchanged (baseline, as of 20261014, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). kabutan shows 8254 as 現物 only: as a 整理銘柄 it has lost 制度信用, so there is no margin long or short and 信用倍率 is '－' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=8254, read 2026-10-15 10:07 JST). No crowded short to squeeze, and no leveraged long forced to sell. Run-up +15.3% over 20d with 5d flat. Turnover is about ¥15.8m/day and today's volume was 8,700 shares by 10:07. No options or skew.

findings.finding: AFC-HD's 2026-09-16 notice schedules the share-exchange agreement that makes Saikaya a wholly-owned subsidiary for '2026年10月中旬', with effect around December, ratio still undecided. Both companies report on 2026-10-15, so the ratio, the third-party valuation range and any premium are likely to land in this window and to set the price directly at ratio x AFC-HD price (846).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-09-09 AFC-HD's first disclosure of the share-exchange intent sent the stock limit-up (249 -> 329, +32%). It then gave back to 285 the next day on 1.7m shares and drifted from 294 to 342 between the 9/16 整理銘柄 designation and today. The 2026-07-29 buyback announcement took it from 284 to 397 in four sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: The ratio itself is unknown to everyone. The price (342 = 0.404 x 846) holds an expectation and not the number: it sits above the 1-month average (~316) and the undisturbed pre-9/9 price (249), and below the August buyback average (~373) and the February warrant initial exercise price (420). If the market had priced a generous ratio, spot would sit near 0.45-0.50 x AFC (380-420); if it had priced a ratio at market, the 16% run-in since 9/16 would not have happened. The lean up rests on the usual premium in parent-subsidiary exchanges and on the minority-protection language in both notices. It is an inference, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Saikaya's own 9/16 delisting notice restates the plan (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260916/140120260916537396.pdf), but it shares the source event. The value references are independent documents: the 2026-09-14 buyback completion shows 215,800 shares bought for 80.4m yen (~373 yen avg) (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260914/140120260914536039.pdf), and the 2026-02-06 allotment set the warrant's initial exercise price at 420 yen (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260206/140120260206550836.pdf). Both are merged here rather than filed separately, because they bear on the same ratio.

findings.finding: The FY8/2026 operating profit plan of 150m needs about 56m in Q4 against 18m in Q4 a year earlier. At Q3, OP was 94m (63% progress) against 84% progress (92/110) at the same point last year, and Q3 ordinary profit was 79m against a 140m plan. A miss on OP and ordinary is likely, but no 業績予想の修正 has been filed although the company files them (it raised its H1 forecast on 2026-04-01), which suggests the miss is under the 30% disclosure threshold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 print on 2026-07-15 (cumulative OP +1.4%, ordinary -37% on a prior-year one-off) was followed by -7.96% (baseline, 2026-07-16). The H1 upward revision on 2026-04-01 lifted the stock the next day (kabutan 2026-04-02).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: anyone can compute the progress rate from the Q3 短信. What remains is the size of the Q4 gap. In a 整理銘柄 the results matter mainly as an input to the DCF leg of the exchange valuation, so the transmission to price is weak.
findings.independence: The 2026-07-15 fixed-asset notices restate the 150m OP plan as 'already built in' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594352.pdf), but they come from the same company and the same date.

findings.finding: A 39.9m special gain (liquidation distribution from the equity holding 藤沢市民会館サービス・センター) is booked in FY8/2027 Q1, already disclosed on 2026-10-07, so it will sit inside the new-year guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock closed 339 on 10/7 and 337 on 10/8, so the disclosure moved nothing visible.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since it was disclosed a week ago. It is below operating income and amounts to about a third of a year's NI. It matters only if it lifts the FY8/27 NI guide or the DCF.

findings.finding: Thin, cash-only (no margin) speculative run-in from 294 to 342 (+16%) since the 9/16 designation, on very low volume (8.7k to 50k shares a day in October), keyed to the 'mid-October' signing date. If the results come without the exchange terms, the holders who bought for the date have no catalyst left.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this line. LESSONS open question 4 records a single case in which a run-in sized as a negative was followed by +8.15%.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-in is visible. What is not priced is whether today is the signing date. AFC-HD said 'mid-October' and gave no day, and if they sign later the event premium bleeds.
findings.independence: AFC-HD's schedule (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260916/140120260916537173.pdf) is the same document as finding 1, so this finding is its non-announcement branch and not an independent signal.

outside_window.finding: Share-exchange effective date around December 2026 and delisting on 2027-03-01. If the agreement is signed after this window, the ratio resolves outside it.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed in advance; an OP shortfall against the 150m plan is likely but probably under the 30% threshold. Returns: the 5 yen FY8/26 dividend is already planned and its record date has passed; buybacks ended 8/31; returns are now irrelevant next to the exchange. New-year guide: FY8/27 guidance will include the 39.9m special gain, but the company delists 2027-03-01. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q3 OP progress 63% against 84% a year earlier, so negative and already visible. The dominant item is the share-exchange ratio, planned for 'mid-October'.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (-0.77, all run-up) and the run-in both cut against a positive. The strongest positive the release could carry is a generous exchange ratio, which I looked for and could not find published. I lean slightly up on precedent and minority-protection language only, so the number stays small. The real content is the large abs_move_pct.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the Q4 progress-rate negative is computable from the last 短信, so it moved from -0.4 to -0.2
Rule 2 and open question 4 (a run-in sized as a short was wrong once): the positioning negative moved from -0.5 to -0.3, and p_up moved from 53 to 54
Finding 1 (exchange ratio) and abs_move_pct were left unchanged
